description.value: Manila Social is a Filipino-inspired restaurant in downtown Kamloops helmed by Chef Romeo Oloresisimo, celebrating traditional Filipino comfort food — from open-flamed rotisserie chicken to classic Silog breakfast plates — with a modern, locally rooted twist. The restaurant serves brunch, lunch, and dinner and offers catering and curated private dining experiences. Situated in the heart of Kamloops' downtown core, it stands out as one of the few dedicated Filipino kitchens in the BC Interior.
